# T6.04: HEVC VPS/SPS/PPS writer

`src/hevchdr.c` / `hevchdr.h` (same bit writer and emulation prevention as `h264hdr.c`): `hevc_write_vps`,
`hevc_write_sps`, `hevc_write_pps` (Annex B), `hevc_level_for`, `hevc_coded_width/height`. The values follow what
nullmoth's library writes (T6.03): Main profile, CB 16..32 (CTB 32), TB 4..32, transform depth 3/3, AMP + SAO, one
short-term RPS in the SPS with N negative pictures none used (slices send their own), no temporal MVP, no strong intra
smoothing; PPS with sign data hiding, CABAC init present, transform skip, CU QP delta (depth 0), loop filter across
slices, deblocking control present.

Ours on purpose:
- **Level from the picture size at 60 fps** (Main tier, A.4.1): 3.1 up to 552,960 pixels, 4.1 up to 1080p, 5.1 up to
  4K, else 6.1. nullmoth's writes 3.0 at 256x128.
- **Conformance window** when the size isn't a multiple of the 16-pixel minimum CB: 1920x1080 is coded as 1920x1088 with
  4 crop units (8 lines) at the bottom. 4:2:0 crops in 2-pixel steps, so an odd size can only be represented one pixel
  larger (3840x2025 → 3840x2026): callers should use even sizes, as nullmoth's library also requires.
- **VUI** with square pixels and a BT.709 colour description plus `video_full_range_flag` (Parsec feeds 420f); nullmoth's
  writes only the aspect ratio.

`tools/hevchdrcheck.m`: for 256x128, 1280x720, 1920x1080, 3840x2160, 3840x2025 and 333x211, CoreMedia's
`CMVideoFormatDescriptionCreateFromHEVCParameterSets` accepts all three NAL units, and the size and clean aperture it
reports match (with the even rounding above). `scripts/hevcps.py` on our 256x128 set vs nullmoth's: PPS identical;
VPS/SPS differ only in `general_level_idc` (93 vs 90) and the VUI colour fields.

`build.sh`: `.m` tools that include `hevchdr.h` link `src/hevchdr.c`.
